title: Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act
full_text:
⊙ Ordinance of the Ministry of Economy and Finance No. 1121 Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act Promulgated as follows. March 21, 2025 Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance (Seal) Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act The Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act are partially amended as follows. In Form No. 4, the portion other than the attached schedules shall be as shown in the attached form. On the reverse side of Form No. 6, in the section headed “Matters to be Confirmed by the Responsible Public Official,” the phrase “Applicable only where the applicant is a business operator” shall be replaced with “Applicable only where the applicant is a business operator; the resident registration number is excluded.” The front side of Form No. 9-2 shall be as shown in the attached form; in item 3 of the instructions on the reverse side of the same form, “date of receipt” shall be replaced with “receipt date”; and an attached table shall be newly added to the same form as shown in the attached form. ADDENDA These Rules shall enter into force on the date of promulgation: Provided, That the amended provisions of Form No. 9-2 shall enter into force on April 1, 2025.
